geometry_review.scope: Independent read-only geometry and actual isolated/static render review. No asset modifications, paid calls or activation.
geometry_review.result: Useful separated component starting point, requires measured local editing and reassembly before animation or deployment. Not a ready-to-animate faithful asset.

component_findings.finding: Several single fragments and several connected bouquets, not one separate object per strand. Parts20/21 are large shared-root masses with numerous strands.
component_findings.feasible_local_work: Multiple weighted chains can exist in a single skinned mesh; hold root caps to Head, assign each strand to its own real chain. Inspect/repair fused bridges and root cuts before weighting. Separate object per strand is not required.

component_findings.finding: Part13 is a large curved blade-like object distinct from housing18 and right hand10. Part1 is a small wrist-side strip. Original source already has an approximate large curved blade, so two film-faithful parallel blades are not established by either source or split.
component_findings.feasible_local_work: Part13 can be moved as one assembly independently from the gauntlet once axis, travel and clearances are measured. Do not count part1 as a complete second blade or claim lost blade caused by AutoSplit.

component_findings.finding: Part9 is an upper plate with raised button-like features, with other walls/panels in6/8 and a long rim in4. No source evidence of the internal opened console or true hinge in this generated body.
component_findings.feasible_local_work: Candidate plate/body geometry can be grouped into a local hinge after inspection; hinge/pivot and complete opening surfaces are not automatically supplied or verified.

component_findings.finding: Body22 excludes hands10/14 and some arm segments such as7. These are retained pieces, not missing parts.
component_findings.feasible_local_work: Recompose all anatomical fragments before body rigging; rigging22 alone would omit required hand/forearm geometry.

component_findings.finding: Caster19 and shoulder plate17 are independent;0/11 are nearby small armor fragments.
component_findings.feasible_local_work: Parent/group after actual component classification and transform calibration.

shape_review.visible_silhouette: Assembled front/side/back retain head, both legs/feet, hands and hair silhouette at capture scale. Source and split overall appearance differ strongly because all texture detail is removed.
shape_review.nearest_vertex_comparison: Median distance0 both ways;95th percentile split-to-source0.004246/source-to-split0.003003 in source height1.901713. This is vertex-cloud distance, not point-to-surface Hausdorff and not1:1 certification.
shape_review.reconstruction: New cut/cap/triangulation geometry exists. All23parts are one index-connected component each; index-edge analysis shows several boundary/nonmanifold edges, which is diagnostic only and not a welded-topology certification.
shape_review.normals: No NORMAL attributes exported. Current GLTFLoader renders visibly faceted; smooth normals may be derived locally, but that does not restore UV/PBR details.

limitations: Static local software-WebGL captures, not hardware performance or animation validation.
No test performed of paid retexturing preserving parts, humanoid rigging multipart anatomy, texture transfer, or hair weighting.
No exact likeness1:1 or film-canonical mechanics certification.

limits: No textures, UVs, exported normals, rig or animations in split GLB.
Separate hands must be reassembled before rigging the body.
A shared hair mesh can receive multiple chains; independent strand weights are not supplied.
Source wrist weapon was already approximate; two faithful film wristblades not proven.
Current production game does not include this pilot model or the new optional articulation descriptor.
